assertions.name: fixed_point_forms_solved
assertions.source: Three self-consistent fixed-point forms (A quadratic, B cubic, C quartic) solved at q_0 (50 dps) and compared to CODATA α_EM⁻¹.

description: Self-consistent fixed-point derivation of α_EM at q_0 using the empirical form α⁻¹ = T + α·H·(1-h²·α+O(α²)) from #1477 and #1480. Solves the resulting polynomial in α numerically at 50 dps; compares to CODATA. If residual < experimental σ_α (0.15 ppb), this constitutes a structural derivation of α from q_0 + Bring data with no free parameters.

B_cubic_schwinger.label: Form B — cubic with -h²·α correction (Schwinger)
B_cubic_schwinger.formula: α³·h²·H - α²·H - T·α + 1 = 0  ⇒  α from polyroots

C_quartic_schwinger_extended.label: Form C — quartic with -h²·α + h⁴·α² correction
C_quartic_schwinger_extended.formula: h⁴·H·α⁴ - h²·H·α³ + H·α² + T·α - 1 = 0  ⇒  α from polyroots

best.label: Form B — cubic with -h²·α correction (Schwinger)
best.formula: α³·h²·H - α²·H - T·α + 1 = 0  ⇒  α from polyroots
